Ceramides make up over 50% of the skin's lipid composition and play a key role in building and strengthening the skin barrier.
Ceramides, cholesterol, and fatty acids work synergistically to form a stronger, more resilient skin barrier.
Ceramides are synthesized by the skin using precursors like glucosylceramides and specific enzymes such as ceramide synthase.
